snippet.title: MOVIE MASHUP - Full Game Mod Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Download - https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rbSJDDVdmidCFwUR8K4qZJysXZlahRXl?usp=drive_link
Discord Server - https://discord.gg/nevd2Jxqqb

Movie Mashup is a full game mod for the Spongebob Squarepants Movie Game that features a whopping 100 tokens, 54 extras, 18 new custom stages, and an original story.

Music is "dnb_hideki-like" by @sethmannerz
